name: Cola nitida extract
description: Cola nitida extract (CAS 84696-01-5 ) is a botanical extract derived from the kola nut, a caffeine-containing seed native to West Africa. It functions as a natural flavoring agent, contributing the characteristic bitter, slightly astringent taste profile associated with cola-type products. In beverage formulation, it provides the authentic cola flavor base used in carbonated soft drinks, energy drinks, and functional beverages where natural sourcing is a label requirement. Confectionery manufacturers incorporate it into cola-flavored candies and chewing gums. The extract is also used in lozenges to replicate the recognized kola taste without synthetic alternatives. In personal care, it appears in scalp tonics and hair care formulations where the extract is positioned as an active botanical ingredient. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulators use it in oral preparations and dietary supplements targeting energy support positioning. The material is often evaluated against USP or FCC standards depending on the specific regional regulatory requirements. Cola nitida extract is supplied as a liquid extract, dry powder, or spray-dried concentrate depending on the intended application. Standard supply grades include food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications, with standardization typically expressed against caffeine content. Buyers should confirm extraction solvent, carrier composition, and standardization ratio when evaluating suppliers for regulatory compliance. Ensuring the material meets Ph.Eur. or BP criteria may be necessary for specific pharmaceutical applications. The extract remains a staple for manufacturers seeking traditional flavor profiles with clean label appeal. Proper storage in cool, dry conditions is essential to maintain the potency of the active alkaloids and the integrity of the sensory profile over time.
